related_resources.reason: Joint distributions, conditional probability and covariance

authorship.scope: Original worked probability and Monte Carlo foundation lecture with mathematical companion; prior manuscripts preserved.

prerequisites.reason: Distributions, expectation and variance of random variables.
Conditional probability and independence in a finite sample space.

background: Arithmetic, fractions, basic functions, and elementary probability; simple integrals for Monte Carlo lectures. No measure theory required.
readiness_checks: Build the joint probability table from four cells and recover both marginals.
Calculate variance of a sum using covariance and check it against an exact distribution.
Give an example of dependent yet uncorrelated random variables.

description: Examines dependence, joint laws, conditional distributions, covariance and uncertainty in sums.
